title: 如何应对人工智能意识的不确定性
summary: 面对AI可能具有意识的不确定性，本文提出将棘手问题转向可处理的AI效价问题，通过评估AI是否具有构成效价体验的状态，为潜在有意识AI的开发提供负责任的方法。
summary_en: Amid deep uncertainty about AI consciousness, this paper proposes shifting from intractable questions to tractable ones about AI valence, assessing whether AI has states that would constitute valenced experiences, grounding a responsible approach to developing potentially conscious AI.
